title: Practice 3: Prefixed verbs of motion, and their other meanings

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Tom runs three or four miles a day.
exercises.why: «про-»: пробегать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«с-»: сходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom was the one who came up with the design.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Drop everything and get over here.
exercises.why: «при-»: приезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том никогда не ___ (выезжать) за пределы Миннесоты.
exercises.prompt: Tom has never travelled outside the confines of Minnesota.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выезжать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (подплыть) по-собачьи к неглубокой части бассейна.
exercises.prompt: Tom dog paddled toward the shallow end of the pool.
exercises.why: «под-»: подплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«до-»: доехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom circled the word with his pencil.
exercises.why: «об-»: обвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: All my settings got wiped out.
exercises.why: «с-»: слететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Christian, you're coughing because you've eaten too much ice cream.
exercises.ru: Кристиан, ты кашляешь, потому что ___ мороженого.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The boy ran away without looking back.
exercises.why: «у-»: убежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A white ship is sailing out of the fog.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от-»: отвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The butterfly fluttered from flower to flower.
exercises.why: «пере-»: перелетать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: How many laps did you swim?
exercises.why: «про-»: проплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«за-»: занести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: I will write to him at once.
exercises.why: «Adding a prefix to the repeated function verbs … usually does not form the perfective aspect but merely changes the meaning of the original verb.» — DLI, Lesson 63. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: She brought a can of hojicha from Japan.
exercises.why: «при-»: привезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: We left early in the morning.
exercises.why: «вы-»: выехать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A gigantic bird came flying toward him.
exercises.why: «под-»: подлететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
